title: Zero Hour isn't in the rule book
sources: Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha

quiz.why: Right. Starred questions are answered orally, so supplementaries can follow.

lines.say: The first hour of a sitting is Question Hour.
What comes right after it isn't in any rule.

beats.say: The first hour of a sitting is Question Hour. What comes right after it isn't in any rule.

lines.say: Starred questions get oral answers, and members can ask follow-ups.
Unstarred ones are answered in writing. Short notice questions deal with urgent matters.

items.sub: On urgent matters, at less than ten days' notice

lines.say: Zero Hour began as a practice in the early 1960s.
Members raise urgent issues without prior notice. It's an Indian innovation.
